views.question: Will NVIDIA commence Vera Rubin production shipments in the second half of 2026?

rungs.label: yes
rungs.condition: NVIDIA commences Vera Rubin production shipments between 2026-07-01 and 2026-12-31.

rungs.label: no
rungs.condition: NVIDIA does not commence Vera Rubin production shipments between 2026-07-01 and 2026-12-31.
